cases.summary: [Bug] devtool failed to build with no permission to create directory when updating kvm-bindings
cases.description:
# Describe the bug
Used `devtool` to build firecracker locally, build failed with failed to create directory issue when updating dependency `kvm-bindings`
```
$ tools/devtool -y build
[Firecracker release.sh 2023-07-12T15:09:26+00:00] Building version=1.5.0-dev, profile=debug, target=x86_64-unknown-linux-musl...
warning: patch for `kvm-bindings` uses the features mechanism. default-features and features will not take effect because the patch dependency does not support this mechanism
    Updating git repository `https://github.com/firecracker-microvm/kvm-bindings`
error: failed to load source for dependency `kvm-bindings`

Caused by:
  Unable to update https://github.com/firecracker-microvm/kvm-bindings?tag=v0.6.0-1#e8359204

Caused by:
  failed to create directory `/usr/local/rust/git/db/kvm-bindings-6ea931839e214d47`

Caused by:
  Permission denied (os error 13)
```
## To Reproduce

* Clone/checkout main branch 
* run command `tools/devtool -y build`

## Expected behaviour

firecracker binary got built

## Environment

```
$ uname -m
x86_64
admin@ip-10-0-0-174:~/firecracker
$ uname -r
5.10.0-23-cloud-amd64
```

## Additional context

Seems related to the development image [tag change from v60 to v61](https://github.com/firecracker-microvm/firecracker/commit/6e973a797ae64c6e6b4d2f665ed320b9b39f32b8#diff-a781bef1e62a4cc6cbc73e5c14ec8a17635e7f2dc36943209f7c9922c24420c5R75) introduced in PR #3904 

Simply change that tag from 61 to 60, build will be happy. 

```
$ git diff tools/devtool
diff --git a/tools/devtool b/tools/devtool
index 308bf6f1..d4319743 100755
--- a/tools/devtool
+++ b/tools/devtool
@@ -72,7 +72,7 @@
 DEVCTR_IMAGE_NO_TAG="public.ecr.aws/firecracker/fcuvm"

 # Development container tag
-DEVCTR_IMAGE_TAG=${DEVCTR_IMAGE_TAG:-v61}
+DEVCTR_IMAGE_TAG=${DEVCTR_IMAGE_TAG:-v60}
```



## Checks

- [x] Have you searched the Firecracker Issues database for similar problems?
- [x] Have you read the existing relevant Firecracker documentation?
- [x] Are you certain the bug being reported is a Firecracker issue?

evidence.eventual_fix_problem_statement:
fix: Comment in dockerfile breaking cargo build

When building the docker image, newlines were removed meaning the commands after the comment about why we do not install kani for aarch64 became part of the comment itself. This resulted in a broken docker image.

Fixes #3960

evidence.eventual_fix_diff:
commit 0bd543ae2ab4d7f03b2a0ecb2fd17c85243d435c
Author: Patrick Roy <roypat@amazon.co.uk>
Date:   Thu Jul 13 15:45:38 2023 +0100

    fix: Comment in dockerfile breaking cargo build
    
    When building the docker image, newlines were removed meaning the
    commands after the comment about why we do not install kani for aarch64
    became part of the comment itself. This resulted in a broken docker
    image.
    
    Fixes #3960
    
    Signed-off-by: Patrick Roy <roypat@amazon.co.uk>

diff --git a/tools/devctr/Dockerfile b/tools/devctr/Dockerfile
index 49a0e136c..10849d058 100644
--- a/tools/devctr/Dockerfile
+++ b/tools/devctr/Dockerfile
@@ -71,12 +71,12 @@ RUN cd /tmp/poetry && \
     HOME=. POETRY_VIRTUALENVS_CREATE=false poetry install --only main --no-interaction \
     && rm -rf ~/.cache ~/.local /tmp/poetry
 
-# Install the Rust toolchain
+# Install the Rust toolchain. Kani only work on x86, so only try to install it there.
 RUN curl https://sh.rustup.rs -sSf | sh -s -- -y --default-toolchain "$RUST_TOOLCHAIN" \
     && rustup target add $ARCH-unknown-linux-musl \
     && rustup component add llvm-tools-preview \
     && cargo install cargo-audit cargo-deny grcov cargo-sort \
-    && (if [ "$ARCH" = "x86_64" ]; then cargo install kani-verifier && cargo kani setup; else true; fi) # Kani only work on x86_64 \
+    && (if [ "$ARCH" = "x86_64" ]; then cargo install kani-verifier && cargo kani setup; else true; fi) \
     && rm -rf "$CARGO_HOME/registry" \
     && ln -s "$CARGO_REGISTRY_DIR" "$CARGO_HOME/registry" \
     && rm -rf "$CARGO_HOME/git" \
diff --git a/tools/devtool b/tools/devtool
index 308bf6f19..9c0702e90 100755
--- a/tools/devtool
+++ b/tools/devtool
@@ -72,7 +72,7 @@
 DEVCTR_IMAGE_NO_TAG="public.ecr.aws/firecracker/fcuvm"
 
 # Development container tag
-DEVCTR_IMAGE_TAG=${DEVCTR_IMAGE_TAG:-v61}
+DEVCTR_IMAGE_TAG=${DEVCTR_IMAGE_TAG:-v62}
 
 # Development container image (name:tag)
 # This should be updated whenever we upgrade the development container.
